// DERIVED FILE, but a COMMITTED SOURCE of k8000: check it in, review its
// diffs, and build from it. Nothing in k8000's lint/build/test reads any
// other repo.
//
// Do not hand-edit: it is emitted by cmd/decoderom from the Z8000 Go golden
// model, and 'make refresh-rtl' (maintainers only, needs that model) will
// overwrite it. What proves it correct HERE is tb_decode_table replaying THIS FILE
// against the committed z8000_decode_rom_gen.sv -- no external repo needed.
//
// z8000_decode_table -- the decode ROM as 478 distinct control words over 3646
// first-word ranges, instead of 65536 opaque hex literals. This is the file to
// read (and to review the diff of) when the decoder changes.
//
// Two record kinds, whitespace separated, '//' and '#' are comments:
//
//   ctrl <NAME> <69-bit hex>      one distinct control word
//   #    <field>=<value> ...      its fields, symbolically (see z8000_ctrl_pkg)
//   range <w0_lo> <w0_hi> <w1> <NAME>
//                                 first words w0_lo..w0_hi inclusive decode to
//                                 NAME; <w1> is '-' when the second word's low
//                                 nibble does not matter, else that one nibble
//                                 (the 3A/3B/BA/BB/1C/5C sub-decoders)
//
// Only fields whose value is non-zero are listed, so a line shows exactly what
// distinguishes that control word. The list is LOSSLESS: decoderom re-packs
// every one of them and fails if the result is not bit-identical to the hex,
// so no field can quietly vanish from this view.
//
// Names are derived (class, ALU op, destination, source) and are for reading,
// not for addressing: a model change can renumber the _2/_3 suffixes.
